sents.t: Whoa! How'd you get it down?
sents.zh: 哇！你怎么把它弄下来的

sents.t: I didn't. But I pushed it out the back window.
sents.zh: 我没有。不过我把它从后窗推出去了

sents.t: Took a while to put back together, but it's fine now.
sents.zh: 花了好一会儿才重新装好，不过现在没问题了

sents.t: Oh, well, thank you, but no thank you.
sents.zh: 哦，嗯，谢谢你，不过还是不用了

sents.t: I mean, I just think maybe I would die.
sents.zh: 我是说，我只是觉得我可能会死

sents.t: Okay, I'll ride it. You hold the ramp.
sents.zh: 好吧，那我来骑。你扶着跳台

sents.t: Sir, maybe we should sleep on it?
sents.zh: 先生，要不我们还是先考虑一晚再说
bkw: 考虑一晚再决定；先别急着决定

sents.t: Whatever you do, do not move!
sents.zh: 不管你做什么，千万别动！

sents.t: I'm not the guy you want for this.
I'm more of an idea man...
sents.zh: 我更像是出主意的那种人……

sents.t: Don't move, don't move, don't move!

cards.ex: Out means from the inside of something to the outside. Alberto pushed the Vespa out the back window, so it went from inside the tower to outside.
exs: She opened the door and ran out into the rain.
cards.note: Day 7 原句：“I didn't. But I pushed it out the back window.”（我没有。不过我把它从后窗推出去了）

cards.ex: A ramp is a flat surface that goes up at an angle. Bikes and skateboards use a ramp to jump into the air.
exs: He rode his bike up the ramp and flew into the air.
cards.note: Day 7 原句：“Okay, I'll ride it. You hold the ramp.”（好吧，那我来骑。你扶着跳台）

cards.zh: 考虑一晚再决定；先别急着决定
cards.ex: Sleep on it means to wait until tomorrow before you decide something, so you have time to think.
exs: It's a big choice. Why don't you sleep on it and tell me tomorrow?
cards.note: Day 7 原句：“Sir, maybe we should sleep on it?”（先生，要不我们还是先考虑一晚再说）

cards.ex: Gravity is the force that pulls everything down toward the ground. Alberto shouts “Take me, gravity!” as he rides down the hill.
exs: Because of gravity, the apple fell from the tree.
cards.note: Day 7 原句：“Take me, gravity!”（带我飞吧，重力！）

items.ex: Out means from the inside of something to the outside. Alberto pushed the Vespa out the back window, so it went from inside the tower to outside.
exs: She opened the door and ran out into the rain.
exzh: 她打开门，跑出去冲进了雨里。

items.ex: A ramp is a flat surface that goes up at an angle. Bikes and skateboards use a ramp to jump into the air.
exs: He rode his bike up the ramp and flew into the air.
exzh: 他骑着自行车冲上跳台，飞到了空中。

items.zh: 考虑一晚再决定；先别急着决定
items.ex: Sleep on it means to wait until tomorrow before you decide something, so you have time to think.
exs: It's a big choice. Why don't you sleep on it and tell me tomorrow?
exzh: 这是个大决定。你不如考虑一晚，明天再告诉我？

items.ex: Gravity is the force that pulls everything down toward the ground. Alberto shouts “Take me, gravity!” as he rides down the hill.
exs: Because of gravity, the apple fell from the tree.
exzh: 因为重力，苹果从树上掉了下来。

items.s: I didn't. But I pushed it ___ the back window.
items.why: pushed it 后面说推到哪里。out 表示从里面到外面，这里是介词，后面接 the back window。
items.ft: I didn't. But I pushed it out the back window.

items.s: Okay, I'll ride it. You hold the ___.
items.why: the 后面接名词。ramp 是“跳台；坡道”，这里只有一个，用单数。
items.ft: Okay, I'll ride it. You hold the ramp.

items.why: should 后面用动词原形。sleep on it 是短语，表示“考虑一晚再决定”。
items.ft: Sir, maybe we should sleep on it?

items.why: Take me 后面叫的是一个名词。gravity 是“重力”，不可数，不加 s。
